PLAY FULL SCREEN ON IPHONE

  1. Tap Safari's Share button (on newer iPhones it's under the ••• button)
  2. Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen, then Add
  3. Open Save Helena from your home screen
It opens like an app, with no browser bars.
